labs.lab_name: Center for the Future of Higher Education and Work (CHEW)
labs.pi_title: Executive Director; Professor of the Practice
labs.research_summary: Northeastern hub that studies and pilots the links between college and work, such as regional skills maps, portable microcredentials and measuring what students learn on co-op, together with employers, colleges and states.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 executive director, 1 senior director, 1 project director, 1 postdoctoral research associate

Sasha Goldman is Senior Director.
